processing_design_facts.purpose: adult and employer needs research for AI4WORK STEP; aggregate needs analysis only

evaluation_or_scoring.reason: only aggregate research synthesis; no person-level evaluation or scoring

automated_decision_with_legal_or_similar.reason: no decisions concerning an individual are permitted

systematic_monitoring.reason: no monitoring of behaviour or publicly accessible areas

sensitive_or_highly_personal_data.reason: special-category, criminal-conviction and direct-identifier fields are forbidden and PII-like free text is rejected

large_scale_processing.reason: final respondent volume, duration and operational scope are not yet approved; repository planning thresholds are not a legal large-scale determination

matching_or_combining_datasets.reason: CRM/contact linkage and cross-dataset identity matching are forbidden

vulnerable_data_subjects.reason: employee respondents may face power imbalance; collection must remain voluntary and individual responses/results must not be disclosed to employers

innovative_technology_or_organisational_.reason: the survey topic is AI but the processing design is a conventional first-party research form; re-screen if AI/ML is introduced into respondent-level processing

prevents_right_or_service_or_contract.reason: participation is optional and must not condition employment, a service or a contract

fail_closed_rule: No PROD collection may be activated while DPIA screening is unresolved. If the controller concludes DPIA is required, collection remains disabled until the DPIA is completed and approved and any Article 36 prior-consultation requirement is resolved.
re_screen_triggers: collection volume or geographic scope materially increases
special-category, criminal-conviction or direct-identifier data are proposed
respondent-level profiling, AI/ML scoring or automated decisions are introduced
employer access to person-level responses is proposed
monitoring, location, device, biometric, sensor or fingerprint data are introduced
purpose, lawful basis, retention, processor chain or security model materially changes
